# HexPiece 2.7.0

The Uo Uo no Mi, with your dragon, and the left hand under Haki. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **New fruit: Uo Uo no Mi** (Mythical Zoan, the Azure Dragon). It is in the fruits' creative tab with the others, eaten the same
  way, and shows in the abilities panel and the Captain's Log.
- **Z: Dragon Form.** Your model, exactly as you sent it, one block per model unit: about 14 blocks tall hovering (over 6 times a
  player) and 25 long, 65 blocks when it stretches out to fly.
  - **Transformation:** your model's own take: the dragon bursts out of your body, grows as it shoots up, arcs over and coils into
    its hover where you stood, in a wide swirl of clouds.
  - **Hover:** your model's idle, looped.
  - **Flying:** it is creative flight underneath (space up, sneak down, sprint for speed, double tap space to take off again after
    landing), so it handles exactly like creative, a little faster. The dragon follows: it uncoils into a long flying body with a
    wave running down it, pitches with your look and banks into turns. Its cloud mantle stays draped over its shoulders (never
    through the body).
  - **Z again:** your model's own take back: it uncoils, dives at you and shrinks back into your body, in clouds.
  - The camera goes to third person and pulls back far enough to see the whole dragon (first person again after, if that is where you
    were). No fall damage when it ends in the air. The sea takes the dragon away.
- **Fixed: the left hand invisible with Haki while holding a katana.** The original's Haki arm told HexPiece "first person" and
  HexPiece read it as "the right arm", so with Haki on it drew your right arm where the left should be, out of sight. It now goes by
  the arm itself (this also put the third-person coat on the wrong side).
- Not in this version yet: the dragon's moves (X, C, V, B; M1, X, C in dragon form), its random colours, and the lag and size pass:
  they are next.
